body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG presented the ‘Simple Link’ enabled LCD TV ''42LC7D''.

The Simple Link was introduced during CEATEC 2006 and received much attention from major consumer electronics companies. The technology allows users to control TV and home theater system with a simple click. Home theater system automatically turns itself off when user turns off TV, and the user can conveniently control DVD or other home theater system on the TV.
All LG LCD TVs that come out in 2007 will have the Simple Link technology inside.
